# Zephyr's built-in adapter targets 4.x. Keep this 3.6 build isolated.
if(CONFIG_MBEDTLS OR CONFIG_PSA_CRYPTO)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Apollo Mbed TLS 3.6 cannot coexist with Zephyr's native 4.x/PSA libraries")
endif()
set(APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR "${ZEPHYR_MBEDTLS_3_6_MODULE_DIR}" CACHE PATH "Mbed TLS 3.6.6 sources")
if(NOT APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR)
    get_filename_component(zephyr_workspace "${ZEPHYR_BASE}" DIRECTORY)
    set(APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR "${zephyr_workspace}/modules/crypto/mbedtls-3.6")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR}/include/mbedtls/build_info.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Mbed TLS 3.6 sources missing; run west update mbedtls-3.6")
endif()
file(STRINGS "${APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR}/include/mbedtls/build_info.h" version_line
    REGEX "^#define MBEDTLS_VERSION_STRING +\"3\.6\.6\"")
if(NOT version_line)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Apollo requires the workspace Mbed TLS 3.6.6 module")
endif()
set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF)
set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF)
set(MBEDTLS_AS_SUBPROJECT ON)
set(MBEDTLS_TARGET_PREFIX apollo36_)
set(MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apollo_mbedtls_config.h" CACHE FILEPATH "Apollo TLS 3.6 configuration" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR lib)
add_subdirectory("${APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/library")
foreach(target IN ITEMS apollo36_mbedcrypto apollo36_mbedx509 apollo36_mbedtls)
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE zephyr_interface)
    target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE apollo36_mbedtls)
message(STATUS "Apollo TLS: Mbed TLS 3.6.6 from ${APOLLO_MBEDTLS_SOURCE_DIR}")
